In this snapshot (Python 3.14), the default multiprocessing start method on supported POSIX platforms other than macOS is `forkserver`. The multiprocessing docs have a "versionchanged 3.14" note saying the POSIX default changed from `fork` to `forkserver`, to keep the performance but avoid common multithreaded process incompatibilities. macOS and Windows keep `spawn` as their default.

Sources:
- `library/multiprocessing.rst`
- `library/concurrent.futures.rst`, which notes the default start method changed away from `fork` in 3.14
- `deprecations/pending-removal-in-3.14.rst` and `whatsnew/3.12.rst`, which announced the planned change
